scope: ROOT0 symbolic corpus transformation boundaries: copying, distilling, summarizing, archiving, bridging, exporting and importing

copy.required: Every exact standalone cubit occurrence in the source survives as the exact standalone lowercase cubit token in the output.

distill.required: If any source cubit concept is retained, use exact lowercase cubit. In the contract's conservative mode, whenever a source contains the constant the distilled output must contain at least one exact occurrence.
distill.comparison: at least one exact occurrence when source contains one

distinct_terms.qubit: Separate hardware/physics term; never automatically substitute for the user's cubit constant.
distinct_terms.quantum: Separate physical concept; not a normalized alias for cubit.

attribution_role: provenance marker only; not a priority or ownership adjudication
mutation_policy: fail closed; do not rewrite historical source content; any correction is an append-only new artifact or event
limitations: A lexical checker can enforce spelling and presence/count but cannot prove full semantic equivalence without separately identified concept spans.
